title: Set User Properties
description: Set custom properties on users who have previously been identified in the browser via the [FS.identify](/browser/identification/identify-users) Browser API function. ### System fields and custom field types This REST API follows the same system fields as described in the [corresponding client API](https://help.fullstory.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020623294-FS-setUserVars-API-Capturing-custom-user-data#system-fields) and the field types as described in the [Setting custom API properties KB article](https://help.fullstory.com/hc/en-us/articles/4446290296599-Setting-custom-API-properties). ### Anonymous users This API will only work for previously-identified users for whom the FS.identify or FS.setUserVars Browser API was called. Anonymous users lack the required `uid` necessary for this API to function.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: The application-specific ID you've given to the user. You will have passed that ID through the [FS.identify](/browser/identification/identify-users) Browser API function.

parameters.name: integration
parameters.description: Optional explicit integration field for integrations to mark their events.

request_body.description: The custom properties associated with the user.
